item.title: react-select vs Downshift vs React Aria in 2026: Which React Select Library Should You Use?
item.description: The native <select> element is the most stubbornly bad control in HTML: you cannot style the dropdown, keyboard navigation is inconsistent across browsers, search is non-existent, and multi-select with tags is simply not possible. So every React team eventually reaches for a select/combobox library — and then discovers that react-select, Downshift, and React Aria approach the problem from three completely different philosophies. Pick the wrong one and you either inherit 100 KB of unstoppable styling you cannot override, or you spend a week wiring up ARIA attributes by hand.
